fields.statement: QA at a1136367 with the built binary in a scratch repo (bare local origin, branch cs/ship-it, all RHIZA_* env cleared): main moved with a conflicting code.txt commit carrying a Change: trailer; rhiza ship rebase exited 1 printing 'conflicts in: code.txt ... left in progress for a fixer', MERGE_HEAD present and code.txt UU, the ship state recorded merge_conflict with files, onto, main's commit subject and its Change: change set and the branch's change set; no question node was written (rhiza ls --kind question: none). After committing a resolving merge by hand, rhiza ship rebase pushed it ('Pushed 79b25ca'), origin's branch fast-forwarded to the local head, the state recorded pushed and dropped merge_conflict. No force or lease anywhere in the ship code's git calls.

QA at a1136367 with the built binary and a fake gh reporting green checks and mergeable CONFLICTING while origin's branch lacks main: with the merge left in progress plain rhiza ship check exited 1 ('failed: merging origin/main into cs/ship-it is unresolved, conflicts in code.txt') though checks were green; after the resolving merge was committed plain ship check exited 0 and ship check --conflicts exited 1 ('is resolved'). With main moved cleanly, ship check --settled merged, pushed a two-parent merge and exited 1 (not settled); with main moved conflicting, ship check --settled --json exited 0 with settled true, conflicts [code.txt] and the merge left in progress, and no question was raised.

QA at a1136367 with the built binary: rhiza workflow check ship-change is valid and workflow describe shows rebase on.fail rebase-triage, rebase-triage on.pass conflict-fix, pr-green and rebased-green on.fail conflict-triage, conflict-triage on.pass conflict-fix / on.fail ci-triage, landed-green and rebase-merge on.fail conflict-triage-landed, conflict-triage-landed on.pass conflict-fix-landed on.pass rebase-merge. In a scratch repo, three conflicts each fixed by a merge commit with the same Review: <run> trailer and pushed by ship rebase: ship check --conflicts (RHIZA_RUN set) exited 0 on the 2nd and 3rd conflicts and exited 1 on the 4th naming 'the run has already made 3 conflict fixes'. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-ship-conflict-fix$' ok (205s).

QA at a1136367: rhiza workflow describe ship-change shows conflict-fix and conflict-fix-landed prompts telling the fixer on a design clash to commit nothing, leave the merge in progress, ask one blocking question naming both change sets, the clashing files and behaviours, and never end the session with the merge in progress. Their until '! git rev-parse --verify --quiet MERGE_HEAD' run by hand in the scratch repo fails (exit 1) while the merge is in progress and holds once it is gone. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-ship-conflict-fix$' ok (205s), covering the autonomous arbiter case, the non-autonomous blocked case and the done-without-commit failure.
